mostWorthwhile.text: Receiving the shipment at the clinic was the strongest payoff: the collection workaround, shared passage and local intake made the delivery concrete without fixing the corporate directory.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the pump and controller at the monitor felt like straightforward preparation rather than meaningful decisions.

surprise.text: Asha's report of a slow tap became new work rather than evidence that the repaired pump had fixed both buildings.

arbitrary.text: The final offered combination with the received shipment had an unclear purpose beforehand, although its result made sense as a request confirmation.

continue.text: I would continue: the delivery had a satisfying payoff, and the open tap request leaves a concrete reason to see what the next shift does.
